minutes.headline: Selectmen approved the land use director plan and recommended it to Town Meeting; White Tail Crossing postponed to fall.
minutes.summary: The board prepared for the Saturday annual town meeting, recommended a prior-year bill article, and held a public hearing on the administrative plan creating a land use director. It voted to approve the plan and recommend it. The DPW director and consultants then reviewed the dam, road funding, the pavement management plan and a draft traffic ordinance.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to approve the administrative plan creating a land use director and to recommend it to Town Meeting.
The board voted to recommend Article 8, a prior-year bill for police injured-on-duty testing above the insurance maximum, at Town Meeting.
The White Tail Crossing road layout hearing was postponed to the fall town meeting at the applicant's request.
The DPW director reviewed road funds, Summer Street and Chase Road engineering, and the pavement management plan; no resolution was reached on funding.
The board will take up a draft traffic ordinance after Town Meeting, and a hearing is required.

why_it_matters: The land use director position adds a salary to the town budget, mostly taxes, and the town manager said it could replace part of legal spending, so voters at Town Meeting will decide on it.
Road funding and engineering costs for Summer Street and Chase Road, and the cost of holding pavement condition, will compete for local money and state road funds in future budgets.
watch_next: The Saturday annual Town Meeting vote on the land use director plan and Article 8.
A public hearing on the draft traffic ordinance after Town Meeting, and the town manager goals discussion at next week's meeting.
